name: generate_ceo_briefing
description: Generate a weekly CEO briefing with executive summary, revenue analysis, completed tasks, bottlenecks, and proactive suggestions. Use this when you need a business overview, weekly report, or executive summary.

days.description: Number of days to analyze (default: 7 for weekly)

save_to_file.description: Whether to save the briefing to Briefings/ folder (default: true)
